class.name: Dialogue
class.brief_description: A resource that defines single dialogue data used in the UT-style dialogue system.
class.description:
This resource contains all information related to a single dialogue sentence. Includes dialogue text, typing speed, character expression change sequences, pause points to insert in the middle of text, etc. The [AdvancedTextTyper] node reads this resource to type text character by character, creating natural dialogue presentation according to the set speed and pause points.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

members.member:
Character expression change sequence according to text progression.
Each element in the array is an integer value representing the index of the expression to display at that sequence. Expressions change sequentially as the text progresses.
[b]Value meanings:[/b] • -1: No expression change (maintain current expression) • 0 or above: Character's expression sprite index

Sets the text typing speed.
Smaller values result in faster typing speed. The default value is 0.08 seconds, meaning one character is typed every 0.08 seconds.

Sets the text content to be displayed in the dialogue.
BBCode tags can be used to freely style text color, size, style, etc.
[b]Examples:[/b] • Normal dialogue: "Hello!" • Emphasized text: "[color=red]Danger![/color]"

Array of [DialoguePause] resources that define pause points at specific character positions during text typing.
Each [DialoguePause] resource includes the character index to pause at and the pause duration. This allows for dramatic effects to be created.
[b]Example settings:[/b] • [DialoguePause( char_index=5, duration=0.5 )]: Pause for 0.5 seconds at the 5th character • [DialoguePause( char_index=10, duration=1.0 )]: Pause for 1.0 seconds at the 10th character
